bull_case: MELI has $6.75B of available liquidity, positive discretionary cash generation, negligible dilution and demonstrated access to long-duration debt. Fintech funding is part of the business model rather than evidence of operating insolvency.
bear_case: Net debt, rapid credit growth and Latin American funding/FX shocks can compress liquidity quickly. H1 adjusted FCF of only $158M leaves less discretionary cushion than GAAP CFO suggests.
thesis: Financial survival is strong but balance-sheet complexity matters. June net debt was $6.425B, yet available liquidity was $6.751B and the company accessed the bond market again in September. Diluted shares were essentially unchanged YoY, and identified uncommenced leases/purchase commitments are well below 0.5x TTM revenue. The main stress risk is a simultaneous credit-loss, funding and FX shock, not routine refinancing.

evidence.claim: At June 30, 2026 MELI reported $6.751B of available cash, investments and digital assets against $13.176B total debt, for $6.425B net debt.
H1 2026 GAAP operating cash flow was $5.737B and adjusted FCF $158M after customer funds, credit receivables, fintech funding and capex adjustments; adjusted FCF remained positive.
Q2 2026 diluted weighted-average shares were 50,697,301 versus 50,697,375 in Q2 2025, effectively flat to slightly lower YoY.
At year-end 2025 disclosed remaining logistics/purchase commitments plus not-yet-commenced warehouse leases were roughly $4.9B, well below 0.5x estimated TTM revenue of about $35.2B.
MELI completed a $1.0B 5.850% senior-note issuance due 2036 in September 2026, demonstrating access to long-duration debt markets.

counterevidence: Net debt increased from $4.682B at year-end 2025 to $6.425B at June 2026 as credit and fintech balances expanded.
H1 adjusted FCF was only $158M, so discretionary cash coverage is far weaker than raw GAAP CFO implies.
The credit portfolio exceeded $16B and grew 75% YoY, increasing sensitivity to funding markets and credit losses.
Brazil, Mexico and Argentina expose liquidity and debt economics to FX, rates and sovereign volatility.
unknowns: Stress liquidity under a simultaneous Brazil/Mexico credit deterioration and FX shock.
Exact cancellation flexibility of warehouse/logistics commitments.
Use of proceeds from the September 2036 notes after settlement.
falsifiers: Adjusted FCF turns structurally negative while credit growth still requires external funding.
Available liquidity falls sharply and short-term funding needs rise simultaneously.
Equity issuance or dilution becomes recurrent because debt/fintech funding cannot support the operating model.

hard_veto_flags.rationale: The company remains adjusted-FCF positive, has substantial liquidity and raises debt against a scaled operating business. Financing supports credit/logistics growth rather than proving ordinary operations cannot survive without repeated equity capital.
Diluted shares are essentially flat to slightly lower YoY, so the long-duration and excessive-dilution elements are false.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 파산 또는 영구손실 확률이 기대수익에 비해 지나치게 높음
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Net debt and macro risk are material, but available liquidity, positive adjusted FCF and debt-market access do not support a meaningful probability of insolvency or business-value extinction at the cutoff.

key_kpis.name: Available liquidity / net debt
key_kpis.threshold: liquidity remains ample relative to corporate and commerce debt

key_kpis.name: Adjusted FCF
key_kpis.threshold: move materially above the H1 2026 level

next_checks: Update liquidity and net debt after Q3 2026 and the September bond proceeds.
Track credit-card NIMAL, NPL and fintech funding mix.
Update logistics/warehouse commitments against TTM revenue annually.

subscores.rationale: MELI has meaningful net debt but $6.75B of available liquidity, positive cash generation and long-duration market access. This fits the 75 strong-liquidity anchor rather than 90 net-cash.
The company can defend operations internally and has multiple funding channels, but a severe credit/FX shock would likely require investment and credit-growth moderation, so 90 is not justified.
Diluted shares are slightly lower YoY and identified uncommenced/purchase commitments are roughly 0.14x TTM revenue, placing both observable axes in the strongest row.

uncertainties.rationale: Fintech liabilities and credit receivables make simple corporate net-debt ratios incomplete.
A correlated regional credit, funding and FX stress has not been observed at the current portfolio scale.
Share dilution is clear; commitment estimates rely on disclosed aggregate contracts and TTM revenue approximation.

dilution_metrics.rationale: Q2 diluted weighted-average shares were effectively unchanged YoY and period-end shares also remain near 50.7M. The run therefore has no dilution watch despite ordinary equity compensation.
